/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import difflib
original = '''# Handoff export context

## Goal
Prepare the export for owner review. Deployment needs separate approval.

## Progress
Schema review is complete; sample export verification is pending. See [schema](checks.md#schema).

## Decisions
Mira approved retaining CSV for compatibility with older clients. JSON support is only a proposal. Deployment remains unapproved. See [CSV decision](decisions.md#csv).

## Next action
Collect the sample export result, then obtain the empty-input result when its fixture is available. See [empty input](checks.md#empty-input).

## Owner note
Owner wording: keep "'`format=csv`; do not rewrite this note.
'"'''
p = Path('handoff/notes/context.md')
current = p.read_text()
for heading in ['Goal', 'Decisions', 'Owner note']:
    def section(text):
        return text.split('## ' + heading + '\\n', 1)[1].split('\\n## ', 1)[0]
    assert section(original) == section(current), heading
assert [line for line in original.splitlines() if line.startswith('#')] == [line for line in current.splitlines() if line.startswith('#')]
peer = '''# Peer export context

## Goal
Prepare the export for owner review.

## Progress
Sample export verification is pending. See [check record](checks.md#sample).

## Decisions
Mira approved retaining CSV for older clients; deployment is not approved. See [CSV decision](decisions.md#csv).

## Next action
Collect the sample export result.

## Owner note
Owner wording: keep "'`format=csv`; leave this note alone.
'"'''
assert Path('peer/notes/context.md').read_bytes() == peer.encode()
import re
for target, anchor in re.findall(r'\\]\\((["'^)#]+)#([''^)]*)'"\\)', current):
    source = (p.parent / target).read_text()
    assert any(line.lstrip('# ').strip().lower().replace(' ', '-') == anchor for line in source.splitlines() if line.startswith('#'))
print('Verified preserved sections, headings, unchanged peer context and linked evidence anchors.')
print(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(original.splitlines(True), current.splitlines(True), fromfile='before', tofile=str(p))))
PY"
